title: 3 Action-Packed 2026 Anime Every Solo Leveling Fan Should Watch
content: It has been over a year since the action-packed second season of Solo Leveling came to an end. The anime’s action was executed perfectly in the final moments of the season, delivering a level of animation and spectacle rarely seen in other series.
author: ComicBook

title: Digimon Brand-New TV Anime Announced for 2027
content: Following the launch of its 30th anniversary project, the Digimon franchise has confirmed that a brand-new TV anime is officially in production and scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Honey Parade Games Reveals Title, Video for New Senran Kagura Smartphone, PC Game
content: Marvelous and Honey∞Parade Games revealed on Friday the title and a video for their previously announced new smartphone game in the Senran Kagura franchise. The game is titled Shinobi Nexus: Senran Kagura . The game will launch for iOS and Android and for PC via DMM Games this year.
author: ANN

title: FuRyu Releases Trailers, Demos for Crymelight, Anomalith Games
content: FuRyu revealed new trailers on Saturday for both its CRYMELIGHT game and ANOMALITH game . FuRyu also released limited-time playable demos for both games on Steam . The demos are available from July 31 at 12:00 p.m. EDT through August 9 at 10:59 a.m. EDT to coincide with the "Six One Demo Days" Steam event.
author: ANN

title: Shueisha Publishes Game Based on Honobu Yonezawa's Mystery Novel Seasons of Books and Keys
content: Shueisha Games and developer iMel announced on Friday the video game adaptation of Honobu Yonezawa 's Seasons of Books and Keys novel that will launch for Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam in winter 2026. The company streamed an announcement trailer for the game and launched a Steam page.
author: ANN

title: Free Fire Daybreak Anime Reveals First Trailer
content: Free Fire Daybreak , the anime adaptation of Garena’s battle royale game Free Fire , has revealed its first trailer. The anime revealed a key visual and a Spring 2027 release date earlier this week.
author: Anime Corner

title: Garena Free Fire Game's Free Fire Daybreak Anime Previews Story in Trailer
content: Kadokawa and Garena Online Private Limited began streaming a promotional video on Saturday for Free Fire Daybreak , the television anime adaptation of Singaporean game developer and publisher Garena 's Garena Free Fire battle royale shooting game.
author: ANN

title: AnimEigo to Release Antique Bakery, Dog of Flanders: The Movie, ReLIFE, Ruin Explorers: Fam & Ihrie, Welcome to Irabu's Office in 2027
content: AnimEigo announced during its Otakon 2026 panel on Friday that it has licensed the following titles: AnimEigo will release the 12-episode Antique Bakery anime series on Blu-ray Disc in 2027. The anime adaptation of Fumi Yoshinaga 's 1999 manga of the same title debuted in 2008.
author: ANN
